fields.statement: Verifier at 3b30a893 (fix for the quality finding on test hermeticity): go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/usage/... passed; go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run 'TestUsage|TestHealth|Limit' passed, including TestUsageLiveLimit (live limit beats the setting and the learned limit, expired snapshot falls back, raised live limit lifts a hold, recorded hit still holds) and TestHealthUsageLiveLimit (health reports weekly N of the live limit). Hermeticity: in a scratch copy under a fake root (rhiza.toml plus .rhiza-root holding an active limit hit to 2100 and 99% live snapshots), the same api tests passed and nothing was written to the fake root's state; with the fix's two test files reverted to HEAD~1, TestUsageHoldProjection, TestUsageWindowsHitKinds and TestSessionRunRecordsLimitHit failed under that root, so the usageFix/limitFixture Wd change is what keeps them out of the real root. Diff read: test-only, sets ctx.Wd outside any root.
